mapper.select: SELECT running.business_type AS businessType, running.cost_type AS costType, running.amount, running.remainingAdvanceAmount, running.remark, creator.name AS createUserName, DATE_FORMAT(running.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createTime FROM ( SELECT ea.*, SUM(CASE WHEN ea.trans_type = 1 THEN ea.amount ELSE -ea.amount END) OVER (PARTITION BY ea.enterprise_id, ea.channel_user_id ORDER BY ea.create_time ASC, ea.id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS remainingAdvanceAmount FROM employee_advance ea WHERE ea.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND ea.channel_user_id = #{request.channelUserId} AND ea.deleted = 1 ) running LEFT JOIN account creator ON creator.id = running.create_by AND (creator.enterprise_id = running.enterprise_id OR creator.account_type = 1) ORDER BY running.create_time DESC, running.id DESC

SELECT id, channel_id, channel_user_id, enterprise_id, business_type, cost_type, amount, remark, trans_type, source_type, import_record_id, import_row_no, transaction_no, deleted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM employee_advance WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND channel_user_id = #{channelUserId} AND trans_type = 1 AND deleted = 1 ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO employee_advance ( id, enterprise_id, channel_id, channel_user_id, business_type, cost_type, amount, remark, trans_type, source_type, import_record_id, import_row_no, transaction_no, deleted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) VALUES
( #{item.id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{item.channelId}, #{item.channelUserId}, #{item.businessType}, #{item.costType}, #{item.amount}, #{item.remark}, #{item.transType}, #{item.sourceType}, #{item.importRecordId}, #{item.importRowNo}, #{item.transactionNo}, 1, #{item.createBy}, NOW(), #{item.updateBy}, NOW() )
